novel_features.name: Offline indicator search
novel_features.description: Search the full ~16,000-indicator catalog by keyword in a single call.
novel_features.rationale: Only possible because the catalog is mirrored to local SQLite with FTS; wrappers hit the live API for every search.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents discover the exact indicator code before fetching values, in one local call.

novel_features.name: Cross-country compare
novel_features.description: Line up one indicator across many countries in a single aligned table with deltas vs a baseline.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join across per-country observation sets that only exists once data is in the store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: One call answers 'how do these economies compare' without N separate fetches.

novel_features.name: Trend / growth stats
novel_features.description: CAGR, year-over-year change, min/max/latest for one country+indicator series.
novel_features.rationale: Computed locally over the full time-series; no API endpoint returns these aggregates.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents get the trajectory summary directly instead of parsing decades of rows.

novel_features.name: Rank countries
novel_features.description: Rank all economies by an indicator for a year, filtered by region or income level.
novel_features.rationale: A cross-entity local join (observations + economy classifications) no wrapper exposes as a command.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find leaders/laggards on any indicator in one call.

novel_features.name: Pipeline export
novel_features.description: Bulk country x indicator pull emitted as pipeline-ready wide or long CSV.
novel_features.rationale: Combines multiple fetches and reshapes locally; the API only returns one long-format envelope per call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Drops straight into notebooks, sheets, and ETL without reshaping.

novel_features.name: Revision diff
novel_features.description: Compare a fresh pull against the last synced snapshot to surface revised observations.
novel_features.rationale: Needs local observation history; the API has no concept of 'what changed since last time'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Detect World Bank data revisions between vintages automatically.

narrative.headline: Every World Bank indicator, queryable offline, with cross-country SQL and rankings no wrapper has.
narrative.value_prop: A single-binary CLI for the World Bank Open Data API. Mirrors the ~16,000-indicator catalog and observations into local SQLite for offline search, then adds cross-country compare, rankings, trend stats, and pipeline exports the Python wrappers and MCP shims don't offer. No API key — World Bank is fully public.

quickstart.comment: confirm the API is reachable (no key needed)
discover the indicator code you want

troubleshoots.symptom: Empty data array for a country+indicator
troubleshoots.fix: Not all indicators cover all economies; try --mrv 5 or a wider --date range.
Use --income or --region filters, or filter by countryiso3code in --select.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when an agent or script needs World Bank development indicators: GDP, population, emissions, poverty, health, education time-series; cross-country comparisons; or rankings. It is ideal for data-pipeline extracts and offline indicator discovery.
anti_triggers: Real-time market/financial prices (use a markets API)
Sub-national or city-level data not in World Bank indicators
